purpose: Authoritative paper-grade run_id per (site|baseline|mode) condition for Phase 1a Pass-1. B-1825 (Fire-6 /stress P0-3-AC*): RESUME_MISSING=1 skips conditions listed here that have a valid condition_summary_v2.json at the expected scored count; the cross-condition aggregator binds to ONLY these run_ids and FAIL-CLOSES on glob-discovered runs not listed (ghost runs from a re-fire / partial / smoke). This closes the 'glob latest run' ambiguity (phase1a_status.sh:94 `ls -dt`) that would silently double-count or cherry-pick when a relaunch produces a 2nd copy of a condition.
condition_key_format: <site>|<baseline>|<mode>  (mode in: dom som vision phantom_text phantom_som phantom_prompt)
